title: Proverbs, Chapter 10 (Leningrad Codex)
source: Leningrad Codex folios (Internet Archive, WSRP photographs) + tanach.us LC folio index + UXLC Hebrew + KJV
description: Proverbs 10 on folios 412v, 413r of the Leningrad Codex (1008 AD), the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Hebrew from the UXLC transcription of this manuscript; English KJV.
introduction:
Proverbs chapter 10 from the Leningrad Codex (Codex Leningradensis, National Library of Russia, Firkovich EBP. I B 19a), copied in Cairo by Samuel ben Jacob and dated 1008/1009 AD, the oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible and the base text of the Biblia Hebraica editions. This chapter stands on folios 412v, 413r.

This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side(s) carrying each section's verses, from the full-colour West Semitic Research Project photographs of the codex as redistributed on Internet Archive (item Leningrad_Codex_Color_Images, marked Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0). Folio-to-verse ranges come from the tanach.us LC folio index, which was derived from the West Semitic Research Project's published index; each section links only to the page(s) whose recorded verse range contains its verses.
  2. Original text: the verbatim Hebrew of this manuscript in the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC 2.5 build 27.6, tanach.us), a transcription of Firkovich B 19a with vowels and cantillation, released without restriction on the biblical text.
  3. English translation: the King James Version (1611, public domain), retrieved verbatim from bolls.life (KJV text, Strong's numbers stripped).
translator_notes: פ and ס mark the open and closed paragraph breaks visible as gaps in the manuscript columns.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>מִשְׁלֵ֗י שְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה פ בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָ֑ב וּבֵ֥ן כְּ֝סִ֗יל תּוּגַ֥ת אִמּֽוֹ׃ <sup>2</sup>לֹא־י֭וֹעִילוּ אוֹצְר֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃ <sup>3</sup>לֹֽא־יַרְעִ֣יב יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְהַוַּ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים יֶהְדֹּֽף׃ <sup>4</sup>רָ֗אשׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה כַף־רְמִיָּ֑ה וְיַ֖ד חָרוּצִ֣ים תַּעֲשִֽׁיר׃ <sup>5</sup>אֹגֵ֣ר בַּ֭קַּיִץ בֵּ֣ן מַשְׂכִּ֑יל נִרְדָּ֥ם בַּ֝קָּצִ֗יר בֵּ֣ן מֵבִֽישׁ׃ <sup>6</sup>בְּ֭רָכוֹת לְרֹ֣אשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃ <sup>7</sup>זֵ֣כֶר צַ֭דִּיק לִבְרָכָ֑ה וְשֵׁ֖ם רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְקָֽב׃ <sup>8</sup>חֲכַם־לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother. <sup>2</sup>Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death. <sup>3</sup>The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked. <sup>4</sup>He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich. <sup>5</sup>He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame. <sup>6</sup>Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked. <sup>7</sup>The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot. <sup>8</sup>The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ׃ <sup>10</sup>קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט׃ <sup>11</sup>מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים פִּ֣י צַדִּ֑יק וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְכַסֶּ֥ה חָמָֽס׃ <sup>12</sup>שִׂ֭נְאָה תְּעוֹרֵ֣ר מְדָנִ֑ים וְעַ֥ל כָּל־פְּ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּכַסֶּ֥ה אַהֲבָֽה׃ <sup>13</sup>בְּשִׂפְתֵ֣י נָ֭בוֹן תִּמָּצֵ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃ <sup>14</sup>חֲכָמִ֥ים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָ֑עַת וּפִֽי־אֱ֝וִיל מְחִתָּ֥ה קְרֹבָֽה׃ <sup>15</sup>ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ מְחִתַּ֖ת דַּלִּ֣ים רֵישָֽׁם׃ <sup>16</sup>פְּעֻלַּ֣ת צַדִּ֣יק לְחַיִּ֑ים תְּבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע לְחַטָּֽאת׃
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known. <sup>10</sup>He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall. <sup>11</sup>The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked. <sup>12</sup>Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins. <sup>13</sup>In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding. <sup>14</sup>Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction. <sup>15</sup>The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty. <sup>16</sup>The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה׃ <sup>18</sup>מְכַסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וּמוֹצִ֥א דִ֝בָּ֗ה ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃ <sup>19</sup>בְּרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֶחְדַּל־פָּ֑שַׁע וְחֹשֵׂ֖ךְ שְׂפָתָ֣יו מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃ <sup>20</sup>כֶּ֣סֶף נִ֭בְחָר לְשׁ֣וֹן צַדִּ֑יק לֵ֖ב רְשָׁעִ֣ים כִּמְעָֽט׃ <sup>21</sup>שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יִרְע֣וּ רַבִּ֑ים וֶֽ֝אֱוִילִ֗ים בַּחֲסַר־לֵ֥ב יָמֽוּתוּ׃ <sup>22</sup>בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הִ֣יא תַעֲשִׁ֑יר וְלֹֽא־יוֹסִ֖ף עֶ֣צֶב עִמָּֽהּ׃ <sup>23</sup>כִּשְׂח֣וֹק לִ֭כְסִיל עֲשׂ֣וֹת זִמָּ֑ה וְ֝חָכְמָ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃ <sup>24</sup>מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth. <sup>18</sup>He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool. <sup>19</sup>In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise. <sup>20</sup>The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth. <sup>21</sup>The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom. <sup>22</sup>The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it. <sup>23</sup>It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom. <sup>24</sup>The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם׃ <sup>26</sup>כַּחֹ֤מֶץ ׀ לַשִּׁנַּ֗יִם וְכֶעָשָׁ֥ן לָעֵינָ֑יִם כֵּ֥ן הֶ֝עָצֵ֗ל לְשֹׁלְחָֽיו׃ <sup>27</sup>יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים וּשְׁנ֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּקְצֹֽרְנָה׃ <sup>28</sup>תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת צַדִּיקִ֣ים שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְתִקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃ <sup>29</sup>מָע֣וֹז לַ֭תֹּם דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃ <sup>30</sup>צַדִּ֣יק לְעוֹלָ֣ם בַּל־יִמּ֑וֹט וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃ <sup>31</sup>פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יָנ֣וּב חָכְמָ֑ה וּלְשׁ֥וֹן תַּ֝הְפֻּכ֗וֹת תִּכָּרֵֽת׃ <sup>32</sup>שִׂפְתֵ֣י צַ֭דִּיק יֵדְע֣וּן רָצ֑וֹן וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation. <sup>26</sup>As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him. <sup>27</sup>The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened. <sup>28</sup>The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish. <sup>29</sup>The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity. <sup>30</sup>The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth. <sup>31</sup>The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out. <sup>32</sup>The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
